notes.title: Major update!
notes.notes:
1. "The visual novel has received a major update with full English localization - now featuring both enhanced literary text and full voice acting! You can switch between them anytime and mix-n-match your preferred subtitles with audio."

2. "We've added a brand new achievement tree! With 50 diverse and challenging achievements to unlock. You'll need to bring your A-game to collect them all!"

3. "Oh, and we've rebalanced everyone's favorite companion - Rakhnov. ;)"

notes.title: New Demo!
notes.notes:
Immerse yourself in a dark story where each of your choices will not only determine the fate of the hero, but also change the course of the investigation. A game for all fans of snowy Siberia, Murder on the Orient Express and mystical stories!

You will enjoy:
1+ hour of gameplay
5 possible endings of the game

Of the special features:
⚡ Demonstration of the character scale of the hero
⚡The scale of influence on satellites
⚡Interactive diary: Keep notes and notes about your companions.
⚡Interactive inventory: All the clues, letters, hints and clues that we find during the investigation are stored there.

notes.title: NEW DEMO l Siberian Way !
notes.notes:
Well, gentlemen! We are happy to present a new demo of the game!
So one of the main moments of our development has come. Next is just the release.

We have done a tremendous amount of work and invested in the game as much as 90% of developers do not.  Especially visual novels.) Each art is hand-drawn by artists, animations of characters, backgrounds, and vfx are added. New backgrounds have been drawn. Interactive features and improved ux-ui have been introduced.  

We have rebuilt the project entirely on the engine. Before that, we used the nani-novell plugin. We abandoned third-party solutions and developed our own tools: We developed a control system that allows you to control the gameplay, create interesting effects and necessary tools focused specifically on our game. 

We have implemented professional tools that help to create high-quality sound.  
And this is only a small part of what will be in the release version of the game! 

So, play it! Add to wishlist and share with your friends! SiberianWay will cover you like an avalanche!
